# How to migrate to Proton using Easy Switch

Reading
:   14 mins

Category
:   Easy switch

Easy Switch is a tool that safely transfers your emails, calendars, and contacts from an external email account to Proton Mail. Your email messages and other data are encrypted the moment they arrive in your Proton Mail inbox, making the transition to a secure email provider easy and risk free.

Transferring your personal data to Proton Mail and Proton Calendar is an important first step towards transitioning away from privacy-invasive companies. If you need more help making the switch, see our dedicated migration guides for Yahoo and Outlook. [...] Easy Switch is fully integrated into Proton Mail, and you can import emails from any email service provider that uses IMAP. Depending on the provider, you can also import your calendars and contacts.

 Gmail

 Other email providers
 Review and customize your import
 Start your import

To launch Easy Switch, sign in to mail.proton.me(new window) and go to Settings → All settings → Import via Easy Switch → select which service you want to import from.

Once configured, Easy Switch works in the background so that you can use your computer as normal while your emails are transferred from your old account to Proton Mail. [...] Easy Switch can transfer data from up to two different email accounts at the same time, but you can only run one transfer at a time from the same account. If you want to run two imports from the same account, you’ll need to wait until the first import is completed before initiating a second import.

To start importing your files from Google, Yahoo Mail, Outlook, or Other email providers, click the appropriate button and follow the steps.

## Gmail

If you’re migrating from Gmail, Easy Switch can import your data and also connect your Gmail account to Proton Mail so you can send and receive emails from your Gmail address without leaving Proton Mail.
